stories.canonicalTitle: The idols on the Kyiv hill — Perun and Mokosh
stories.editorialNote: 依据《往年纪事》980 与 988 年条；编年史由皈依后的基督教修士编写，对旧信仰的描述带有立场；莫科什在此只有名字。
stories.summaryEn: The Primary Chronicle's annal for 980: Volodimer sets up idols on the hill outside his Kyiv palace — a wooden Perun with a silver head and golden moustache, then Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl and Mokosh — and people make offerings to them. After his baptism in 988 he has them cast down; Perun is tied to a horse's tail, dragged down the hill and thrown into the Dnieper.
stories.summaryZh: 《往年纪事》980 年条：弗拉基米尔在基辅宫殿外的山岗上立起神像——银头金须的木雕佩伦，还有霍尔斯、达日博格、斯特里博格、西马尔格尔和莫科什，人们向它们献祭。988 年他受洗后下令推倒神像，佩伦被绑在马尾上拖下山，丢进第聂伯河。
stories.titleZh: 基辅山岗上的神像：佩伦与莫科什

claims.statement: The chronicle gives Mokosh's name but no story, function or image; it was written by Christian clergy after the conversion.
Mokosh is the last name in the 980 list of idols: Perun, Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl and Mokosh.
In 988 Volodimer orders the idols overthrown; Perun's image is tied to a horse's tail, beaten with sticks, dragged down the hill and thrown into the Dnieper.
The 980 annal records Volodimer setting up idols on the hill outside the palace hall in Kyiv.
The 980 annal describes a wooden Perun idol with a silver head and golden moustache on the Kyiv hill.
Mokosh is one of the idols Volodimer sets up on the Kyiv hill, to which people make offerings.
Perun heads the 980 list of idols on the Kyiv hill.

entities.canonicalName: Volodimer's idols on the Kyiv hill (980)
The Kyiv idols are cast down (988)

events.summaryEn: The Primary Chronicle's annal for 980 records that when Volodimer began to reign alone in Kyiv, he set up a row of idols on the hill outside the palace courtyard.
events.summaryZh: 《往年纪事》980 年条记载：弗拉基米尔开始在基辅独自为王，就在宫殿庭院外的山岗上立起一排神像。

events.summaryEn: First stood Perun, carved of wood, with a silver head and a golden moustache.
events.summaryZh: 最前面的是佩伦：木头雕成，头是银的，胡须是金的。

events.summaryEn: Then came Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog and Simargl, and last on the list, Mokosh.
events.summaryZh: 接下来是霍尔斯、达日博格、斯特里博格、西马尔格尔，名单的最后一位是莫科什。
events.titleEn: Mokosh at the end of the list
events.uncertaintyNote: 关于莫科什职能的说法来自其他材料与现代研究，本故事不补写。

events.summaryEn: Eight years later Volodimer was baptized and ordered the idols overthrown — some cut to pieces, others burned.
events.summaryZh: 八年后，弗拉基米尔受洗，下令推倒这些神像：有的砍碎，有的烧掉。
events.uncertaintyNote: 这是皈依一方的记载，不是对斯拉夫宗教的中立描述。

stories.canonicalTitle: Mithra of the wide pastures — the Mihr Yasht
stories.editorialNote: 依据达梅斯特泰尔译本（avesta.org）第10颂第1、2、7、13节；现代学者对诗句的理解另有讨论。
stories.summaryEn: The Mihr Yasht, tenth hymn of the Avesta: Ahura Mazda says he made Mithra as worthy of sacrifice and prayer as himself; whoever lies to Mithra and breaks the contract brings death to the whole land; Mithra has a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes and is the first god to rise over Mount Hara, before the swift-horsed sun.
stories.summaryZh: 阿维斯塔第十颂《密赫尔颂》：阿胡拉·马兹达说，他创造密特拉时，使他与自己同样值得祭祀和祈祷；对密特拉说谎、背弃契约的人会给整个国家带来死亡；密特拉有千只耳朵、万只眼睛，在不朽的快马太阳之前最先越过哈拉山。
stories.titleZh: 广阔牧场之主密特拉：《密赫尔颂》

claims.statement: The Mihr Yasht is Yasht 10 of the Avesta.
The hymn repeatedly calls Mithra 'lord of wide pastures'.
The one who lies to Mithra — who breaks the contract — brings death to the whole land; the contract must be kept with the faithful and the unfaithful alike.
Ahura Mazda tells Zarathustra that when he created Mithra, lord of wide pastures, he made him as worthy of sacrifice and prayer as himself.
Mithra is truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, with a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes.
He is the first of the heavenly gods to reach over Mount Hara, before the undying swift-horsed sun.

events.summaryEn: The hymn opens with Ahura Mazda telling Zarathustra: when I created Mithra, lord of wide pastures, I made him as worthy of sacrifice and as worthy of prayer as myself.
events.summaryZh: 颂歌一开头，阿胡拉·马兹达对查拉图斯特拉说：我创造广阔牧场之主密特拉时，使他与我自己一样，值得献祭、值得祈祷。

events.summaryEn: The wretch who lies to Mithra, breaking the contract, brings death upon the whole land.
events.summaryZh: 对密特拉说谎、背弃契约的恶人，会给整个国家带来死亡。
events.uncertaintyNote: “契约”是译者对 miθra 一词的理解，学界另有讨论。

events.summaryEn: The hymn praises Mithra as truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, with a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes — nothing escapes him.
events.summaryZh: 颂歌赞美密特拉说真话，是集会中的首领；他有一千只耳朵，一万只眼睛，什么都瞒不过他。
events.titleEn: A thousand ears, ten thousand eyes

events.summaryEn: Each morning he is the first of the heavenly gods to reach over Mount Hara, ahead of the undying, swift-horsed sun.
events.summaryZh: 每天清晨，他是天上诸神中第一个越过哈拉山的，比不朽的、驾着快马的太阳还要早。

versions.labelZh: 达梅斯特泰尔英译《密赫尔颂》
versions.narrativeScope: 与阿胡拉·马兹达同受崇拜、守护契约、千耳万眼与越过哈拉山
versions.rightsNote: 达梅斯特泰尔 19 世纪译本属公共领域；这是活态宗教的经典，只作尊重的独立概述，不涉及仪轨。

sections.bodyEn: The hymn opens with Ahura Mazda telling Zarathustra: when I created Mithra, lord of wide pastures, I made him as worthy of sacrifice and as worthy of prayer as myself.
sections.bodyZh: 颂歌一开头，阿胡拉·马兹达对查拉图斯特拉说：我创造广阔牧场之主密特拉时，使他与我自己一样，值得献祭、值得祈祷。

sections.bodyEn: The wretch who lies to Mithra, breaking the contract, brings death upon the whole land. So the contract must never be broken, whether made with one of the faithful or with an unbeliever.
sections.bodyZh: 对密特拉说谎、背弃契约的恶人，会给整个国家带来死亡。所以契约绝不可背弃——不论是与信徒订立的，还是与不信者订立的。
sections.uncertaintyNote: “契约”是译者对 miθra 一词的理解，学界另有讨论。

sections.bodyEn: The hymn praises Mithra as truth-speaking, a chief in assemblies, with a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes — nothing escapes him.
sections.bodyZh: 颂歌赞美密特拉说真话，是集会中的首领；他有一千只耳朵，一万只眼睛，什么都瞒不过他。
sections.headingEn: A thousand ears, ten thousand eyes

sections.bodyEn: Each morning he is the first of the heavenly gods to reach over Mount Hara, ahead of the undying, swift-horsed sun.
sections.bodyZh: 每天清晨，他是天上诸神中第一个越过哈拉山的，比不朽的、驾着快马的太阳还要早。

stories.canonicalTitle: Sixteen good lands and their plagues — Videvdad 1
stories.editorialNote: 依据达梅斯特泰尔译本（avesta.org）第一章；译者认为这是伊朗的宗教地理，而不是迁徙记录。
stories.summaryEn: Videvdad 1: Ahura Mazda makes sixteen good lands, the first being Airyana Vaejah by the good river Daitya; for each, Angra Mainyu, who is all death, counter-creates a plague — the serpent in the river and winter for the first, the locust for the second.
stories.summaryZh: 《万迪达德》第一章：阿胡拉·马兹达创造了十六片良地，第一片是善河岱提亚旁的雅利安瓦伊贾；每创造一片，“全然是死亡”的安格拉·曼纽就造出一种灾祸与之对抗——第一片是河中之蛇和寒冬，第二片是蝗虫。
stories.titleZh: 十六片良地与它们的灾祸：《万迪达德》第一章

claims.statement: Darmesteter argues the chapter is a religious geography of Iran mixing mythic lands and real countries, not a record of migrations; only some lands can be identified.
Ahura Mazda says the first of the good lands he created was Airyana Vaejah, by the good river Daitya.
Then Angra Mainyu, who is all death, counter-creates the serpent in the river and winter, a work of the daevas.
The list continues land by land — the second, the plains of the Sughdhas, is answered by the locust — until sixteen lands and sixteen plagues are named.
Ahura Mazda makes the sixteen good lands.
Angra Mainyu sets a counter-creation against each land.
Throughout Videvdad 1 every good land made by Ahura Mazda is answered by a plague from Angra Mainyu.

stories.canonicalTitle: Pele's journey to Halemaʻumaʻu
stories.editorialNote: 须署名的公开概述：依据美国国家公园管理局两页公开介绍；各家族与地方的 moʻolelo 版本差异很大，本站不收集。
stories.summaryEn: The National Park Service summarizes Hawaiian oral history: the volcano deity Pele was born in distant Kahiki and voyaged to the Hawaiian Islands seeking a home for her fire and family, moving southeast until she settled in Halemaʻumaʻu crater at the summit of Kīlauea, where she is said still to live. In Hawaiian tradition one asks her permission to travel through her land.
stories.summaryZh: 美国国家公园管理局概述夏威夷口述传统：火山女神佩蕾生在遥远的卡希基，为寻找适合她的火与家人的居所，远航来到夏威夷群岛，一路向东南迁移，最后在基拉韦厄山顶的哈雷茂茂火山口安家，据说至今仍住在那里。按照夏威夷传统，经过她的土地要先请求许可。
stories.titleZh: 佩蕾的旅程：从卡希基到哈雷茂茂

claims.statement: NPS describes Pele as the Hawaiian volcano deity, an elemental force and the creator of the volcanic landscapes.
NPS notes that different versions of the moʻolelo may vary, in some cases significantly; this story follows only the park's public summary.
Pele's permanent home is Halemaʻumaʻu crater at the summit of Kīlauea, where she is said still to reside.
Oral history says Pele was born in the distant land of Kahiki and voyaged to the Hawaiian Islands in search of a suitable home.
In Hawaiian tradition it is customary to ask Pele's permission to travel through her land, and NPS asks visitors to behave respectfully in this sacred landscape.
She migrates southeast through the islands before reaching Kīlauea.

stories.canonicalTitle: The Monkey King: from the stone egg to Havoc in Heaven
stories.editorialNote: 明代小说属于后世文学接受层；本站按回目顺序独立讲述，不当作古代神话见证。
stories.summaryEn: The full opening arc of Journey to the West: a stone on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit gives birth to a monkey who becomes king of the Water Curtain Cave, crosses the seas to learn immortality, the seventy-two transformations and the somersault cloud, takes the iron staff from the Dragon King, strikes his name from the register of death, scorns heaven's offices, eats the peaches and elixir, defeats heaven's armies, survives the furnace with fiery golden eyes, and is finally pinned under the Mountain of Five Elements by Rulai.
stories.summaryZh: 《西游记》前七回的完整讲述：花果山仙石孕出石猴，他在水帘洞称王，又为躲避死亡漂洋求道，从须菩提祖师那里学会七十二变和筋斗云；回山后到龙宫取走如意金箍棒，在地府勾掉生死簿；天庭先封他弼马温、后封齐天大圣，他却偷吃蟠桃和金丹，打退十万天兵；最后被二郎神擒住，八卦炉炼出火眼金睛，终被如来压在五行山下。
stories.titleZh: 美猴王：从石猴出世到大闹天宫

claims.statement: A stone on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit splits into a stone egg that becomes a monkey whose eyes flash light to heaven.
The stone monkey leaps through the waterfall, finds the Water Curtain Cave and is acclaimed Handsome Monkey King.
Grieving that the King of the Dead will one day claim him, the Monkey King sails alone across the sea to seek immortality.
Patriarch Subodhi receives the monkey at the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars and names him Sun Wukong.
Understanding the patriarch's three blows as a riddle, Wukong is secretly taught long life, the seventy-two transformations and the somersault cloud.
After Wukong shows off by becoming a pine tree, the patriarch expels him and forbids him ever to name his teacher.
Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea, lets Sun Wukong take the 13,500-pound iron that becomes the Compliant Golden-Hooped Rod.
Dragged to the underworld in a dream, Wukong strikes his own name and those of all monkeys from the Register of Life and Death.
On Venus's advice the Jade Emperor summons Wukong to heaven and appoints him Keeper of the Heavenly Horses, a post without rank.
After Heavenly King Li and Nezha fail to capture him, the Jade Emperor grants Wukong the empty title Great Sage Equal to Heaven and builds him a mansion.
Put in charge of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, Wukong secretly eats the ripest peaches and learns he is not invited to the Peach Banquet.
Wukong drinks the banquet wine, eats Laozi's elixir pills and holds off a hundred thousand heavenly soldiers at his mountain.
Erlang matches every transformation of the Great Sage until Laozi's Diamond Snare and Erlang's hound bring him down.
Laozi refines the captured Great Sage in his Eight Trigrams furnace for forty-nine days; he emerges with fiery golden eyes and kicks the furnace over.
Rulai wagers that the Great Sage cannot somersault out of his right palm; the monkey leaps and reaches five pink pillars he takes for the edge of heaven.
Rulai reveals the Great Sage's graffiti on his own finger and turns his hand into the Mountain of Five Elements, pinning the monkey beneath it.

entities.canonicalName: Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea
Havoc in Heaven (Journey to the West, chapters 1–7)
entities.nameZh: 大闹天宫（《西游记》第一至七回）

events.summaryEn: Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began.
events.summaryZh: 东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。
events.titleEn: A stone gives birth to a monkey
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain.
events.summaryZh: 石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。
events.titleEn: King of the Water Curtain Cave
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept.
events.summaryZh: 有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit.
events.summaryZh: 木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。
events.titleEn: The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years.
events.summaryZh: 悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。
events.titleEn: A secret lesson at the third watch
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause.
events.summaryZh: 一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Needing a weapon, Wukong dived to the Crystal Palace of Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea.
events.summaryZh: 悟空操练群猴，却没有一件称手的兵器。
events.titleEn: A weapon from the Dragon King
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: After a drunken feast with six demon kings, Wukong dreamed that two summoners roped his soul and dragged it to the Land of Darkness.
events.summaryZh: 悟空回山后，又与牛魔王等六位妖王结为兄弟，天天宴饮。
events.titleEn: Striking out the Register of Death
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: As the Jade Emperor prepared to send troops, the Gold Star of Venus advised him to summon the monkey with a decree of amnesty and keep him in heaven under a title.
events.summaryZh: 玉帝看了两道表文，正要派兵捉拿，太白金星出班奏道：这猴子是天地育成之体，不如降一道招安圣旨，把他宣上天来，给他一个官职，拘束在此，若他受天命，以后再加升赏；若违天命，就地擒拿。
events.titleEn: Heaven's first office: Keeper of the Horses
events.titleZh: 天庭的第一份官职：弼马温
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Wukong raised a banner reading 'Great Sage Equal to Heaven'.
events.summaryZh: 悟空在洞门外竖起一面大旗，上书“齐天大圣”四个大字。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: With nothing to do, the Great Sage wandered heaven befriending stars.
events.summaryZh: 大圣在天上无事可做，今天东游，明天西荡，和众星宿称兄道弟。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Freezing the fairies with an immobilising spell, the Great Sage flew to the Jade Pool, put the wine-makers to sleep with sleep-insects made from his hairs and drank himself senseless.
events.summaryZh: 大圣用定身法把七位仙女定在树下，驾云直奔瑶池。
events.titleEn: Stolen wine, stolen elixir and heaven's army
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Guanyin recommended the Jade Emperor's nephew, the Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang.
events.summaryZh: 观音菩萨赴蟠桃会，听说此事，先派徒弟惠岸行者下界交战，也败了回来。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Bound at the execution terrace, the Great Sage could not be hurt by sword, axe, fire or thunder: the peaches, wine and elixir had made his body adamantine.
events.summaryZh: 大圣被押到斩妖台，绑在降妖柱上。
events.titleEn: Fiery golden eyes in the Eight Trigrams furnace
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: Surrounded by Wang Lingguan and thirty-six thunder generals, the Great Sage fought them off with three heads, six arms and three staffs, until the Jade Emperor sent to the West for Rulai.
events.summaryZh: 王灵官和三十六员雷将把大圣团团围住，大圣变出三头六臂，把金箍棒幌一幌变成三根，六只手使开，打得雷将们近不了身。
events.uncertaintyNote: 神话地点不推测坐标。

events.summaryEn: To prove his journey he made a brush from a hair, wrote 'The Great Sage Equal to Heaven was here' on the middle pillar, and relieved himself at the foot of the first.
events.summaryZh: 大圣心想：我到了这里，回去跟如来做个凭证。
events.titleEn: Under the Mountain of Five Elements
events.uncertaintyNote: “五百年”的时间与后来唐僧解救的情节见于第八回之后，本篇只讲到被压为止。

versions.rightsNote: 小说原文属公共领域；本站发布的是按回目顺序的独立白话讲述。

sections.bodyEn: Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began. One day it split open and released a stone egg; touched by the wind, the egg became a stone monkey. He bowed to the four quarters and beams of golden light shot from his eyes to the palace of the Pole Star. The Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to look; told it was only a monkey born of a stone, he declared such things unremarkable.
sections.bodyZh: 东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。这块石头高三丈六尺五寸，围圆二丈四尺，自开天辟地以来就吸收着天地的灵气和日月的精华，久而久之有了灵通。有一天，仙石崩裂，生出一枚石卵，石卵被风一吹，化成一只石猴，五官俱全，四肢皆备。石猴学会了爬和走，向四方拜了一拜，两只眼睛里射出两道金光，直冲天上的斗府。玉皇大帝被惊动，派千里眼和顺风耳打开南天门查看。两位神将回报说：那是花果山上仙石生出的一只猴子，如今他吃了东西、喝了水，金光就要渐渐消退了。玉帝听了说：下方之物，都是天地精华所生，不足为奇。——谁也没想到，这只猴子后来会把天宫闹得天翻地覆。
sections.headingEn: A stone gives birth to a monkey

sections.bodyEn: The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain. One hot summer they followed a stream up to a great waterfall and promised to make king whoever could pass through it unharmed. The stone monkey shut his eyes and leapt through. Behind the falling water lay an iron bridge and a cave-home furnished by nature with stone pots, beds and benches, and an inscription naming it the Water Curtain Cave of the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He led the monkeys inside, they bowed to him as the Handsome Monkey King, and he lived there freely for three or five hundred years.
sections.bodyZh: 石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。一个炎热的夏天，群猴在涧中洗澡，想去看看这股水从哪里来，便顺着山涧往上爬，一直找到一道大瀑布前。群猴拍手说：谁能钻进瀑布，找到源头又不伤身体，我们就拜他为王！石猴应声而出，闭上眼睛纵身一跳，竟穿过了瀑布。瀑布后面是一座铁板桥，桥那边是一处天造地设的洞府，石锅石灶、石床石凳一应俱全，石碣上刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”。石猴跳出来把群猴都领了进去，群猴依约向他跪拜，称他为“美猴王”。从此他去掉“石”字，自称“千岁大王”，在水帘洞里过了三五百年自在的日子。
sections.headingEn: King of the Water Curtain Cave

sections.bodyEn: One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept. Though no human law ruled them and no beast threatened them, he said, one day they would grow old and the King of the Dead would claim them. An old gibbon told him that only buddhas, immortals and sages escape the wheel of rebirth. Overjoyed, the Monkey King resolved to find them and learn the way to live forever. The next morning the monkeys feasted him with fruit, and he set off alone across the ocean on a raft of pine logs with a bamboo pole.
sections.bodyZh: 有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。群猴问他为何烦恼，他说：我们现在虽然不受人间王法管束，也不怕飞禽走兽，可将来年老血衰，暗中有阎王老子管着，一旦死去，岂不白白在世上走了一遭？群猴听了，也都掩面悲啼。这时一只通背猿猴跳出来说：大王能想到这一层，就是道心开发了。五虫之中，只有三等名色不归阎王管——就是佛、仙与神圣，他们躲过轮回，与天地山川同寿。美猴王大喜，决心云游海角，去寻访这三等人物，学一个长生不老的法子。第二天，群猴摘来仙桃异果为他送行，他独自砍了松木扎成木筏，拿一根竹竿当篙，漂洋过海而去。

sections.bodyEn: The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit. Crossing another ocean to the Western Continent, he heard a woodcutter singing an immortal's song and was directed to the Patriarch Subodhi of the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars on the Mountain of Mind. The patriarch, seeing a monkey (husun), gave him the surname Sun by removing the animal radical, and from the generation character wu named him Sun Wukong, 'Awakened to Emptiness'.
sections.bodyZh: 木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。美猴王上岸学人说话、穿人衣服，在市井里走了八九年，看到的都是为名为利奔忙的人，没有一个修仙的。他又扎筏渡过西洋大海，来到西牛贺洲。在一座高山上，他听见一个樵夫唱着仙家的歌，樵夫说歌是邻居一位神仙教的，那位神仙住在灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞，名叫须菩提祖师。美猴王找到洞门，等了半天，一个仙童开门迎他进去。祖师问他姓什么，他说“我无性，人若骂我，我也不恼”；又问籍贯，他说从东胜神洲来。祖师看他像个猢狲，便把“猢狲”去掉兽旁，给他姓“孙”，再按门中“广大智慧真如性海颖悟圆觉”十二字排到“悟”字，取名“孙悟空”。
sections.headingEn: The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars

sections.bodyEn: Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years. When the patriarch offered him various arts, he refused each because none brought eternal life. Feigning anger, the patriarch struck him three times on the head, clasped his hands behind his back and shut the inner door. Wukong understood the riddle: come at the third watch, by the back door. That night the patriarch taught him the secret of long life, later the seventy-two earthly transformations to escape the calamities that strike immortals every five hundred years, and finally the somersault cloud that carries him 108,000 li in a single leap.
sections.bodyZh: 悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。有一天祖师登坛讲道，问他想学什么：讲术、流、静、动各门，可以请仙问卜、读经念佛、打坐参禅、采阴补阳，悟空每听一门都先问一句“能长生吗”，听说不能，就一概不学。祖师假装发怒，跳下高台，拿戒尺在他头上打了三下，背着手走进里屋，关上了中门。众师兄都埋怨他，悟空却心里明白：打三下，是叫他三更时分去；背着手进去、关中门，是叫他从后门进来。当夜三更，他果然从后门溜进祖师卧房跪下。祖师见他领悟了哑谜，便把长生妙道的口诀传给他。三年之后，祖师又说修成的人每五百年要遭雷灾、火灾、风灾，便教他躲灾的七十二般地煞变化；后来又传他一个筋斗云，一翻就是十万八千里。
sections.headingEn: A secret lesson at the third watch

sections.bodyEn: One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause. The patriarch, disturbed by the noise, rebuked him: an adept must not show off, for others will covet the art and trouble will follow. He sent Wukong away at once, forbidding him ever to name his teacher. Wukong somersaulted home, found that a Demon King of Confusion had seized his cave, plucked a handful of hairs that became hundreds of little monkeys, and killed the demon.
sections.bodyZh: 一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。悟空经不住夸，捻着诀念动咒语，摇身一变，就变成一棵松树，众人齐声喝彩。吵闹声惊动了祖师，祖师把悟空叫来责备：修行之人不可在人前卖弄，别人见了要求你，你不教就会招来祸患。他命悟空立刻离开，并且叮嘱：此去无论惹出什么祸来，都不许说是我的徒弟，你只要说出半个字来，我就把你神魂贬在九幽之处。悟空含泪拜别，一个筋斗回到花果山。他得知一个混世魔王趁他不在，霸占了水帘洞、掳走了小猴，便找上门去，拔一把毫毛变出几百个小猴，把魔王打死，夺回了洞府。

sections.bodyEn: Needing a weapon, Wukong dived to the Crystal Palace of Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea. A broadsword, a nine-pronged fork of 3,600 pounds and a halberd of 7,200 pounds were all too light. The Dragon Queen suggested the divine iron that had fixed the depth of the Milky Way, which had lately been glowing. It was a pillar inscribed 'Compliant Golden-Hooped Rod, weight 13,500 pounds', and it shrank at his command until it was the size of an embroidery needle, which he kept behind his ear. He then bullied the dragon kings of the four seas into giving him cloud-walking shoes, golden mail and a phoenix-feather cap.
sections.bodyZh: 悟空操练群猴，却没有一件称手的兵器。他得知花果山下的铁板桥直通东海龙宫，便捻着闭水诀钻进水里，向东海龙王敖广讨兵器。龙王先后拿出一把大刀、一柄重三千六百斤的九股叉、一杆重七千二百斤的方天画戟，悟空都嫌太轻。龙婆、龙女出主意说：海藏里那块天河定底的神珍铁，这几天霞光艳艳，莫非是该出世遇此圣人？悟空过去一看，是一根斗来粗、二丈多长的铁柱，两头是金箍，中间刻着“如意金箍棒，重一万三千五百斤”。他说声“再短细些”，铁棒就随心变小，最后成了绣花针大小，藏进耳朵里。他又逼着四海龙王凑出藕丝步云履、锁子黄金甲和凤翅紫金冠，才心满意足地回山。
sections.headingEn: A weapon from the Dragon King

sections.bodyEn: After a drunken feast with six demon kings, Wukong dreamed that two summoners roped his soul and dragged it to the Land of Darkness. Furious — had he not passed beyond the Three Realms? — he beat them to pulp with his staff and stormed the palace of the Ten Kings of the Underworld. There he found his own entry, 'Sun Wukong, stone monkey born of heaven, allotted 342 years, to die a good death', and with a brush struck out his name and those of all monkeys. When he woke, the Dragon King and the King Qinguang of the underworld each sent complaints to heaven.
sections.bodyZh: 悟空回山后，又与牛魔王等六位妖王结为兄弟，天天宴饮。一天他喝醉了，在松树下睡着，梦见两个人拿着勾魂的牌子，用绳子套住他的魂魄，一直拉到幽冥界。悟空看见城上写着“幽冥界”，大怒道：我老孙早已超出三界之外，跳出五行之中，凭什么来勾我？他从耳中掏出金箍棒，把两个勾死人打成肉酱，一路打进森罗殿。十殿阎王只好叫判官拿出生死簿给他看。悟空翻到“魂字一千三百五十号”，上面写着“孙悟空，天产石猴，该寿三百四十二岁，善终”。他索性拿笔把自己和猴类的名字一概勾掉，扔下簿子打出幽冥界。醒来后，东海龙王和地府的秦广王先后上表天庭，状告这只妖猴。
sections.headingEn: Striking out the Register of Death

sections.bodyEn: As the Jade Emperor prepared to send troops, the Gold Star of Venus advised him to summon the monkey with a decree of amnesty and keep him in heaven under a title. Wukong happily accepted and was appointed Keeper of the Heavenly Horses, tending them so well that they grew sleek within a fortnight. At a banquet he learned that the post had no rank at all. Enraged at having been tricked into grooming horses, he overturned his desk, fought his way out through the Southern Gate and returned home, where a demon king urged him to proclaim himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven.
sections.bodyZh: 玉帝看了两道表文，正要派兵捉拿，太白金星出班奏道：这猴子是天地育成之体，不如降一道招安圣旨，把他宣上天来，给他一个官职，拘束在此，若他受天命，以后再加升赏；若违天命，就地擒拿。玉帝准奏。悟空欢喜上天，被封为御马监的弼马温。他尽心尽力，半个月里把天马养得肉肥膘满。一天同僚设宴，他问起弼马温是几品官，众人说：这官没有品从，叫作“未入流”，养得好不过是一声“好”，养瘦了还要受罚。悟空听了大怒：老孙在花果山称王称祖，怎么骗我来替他养马！他推倒公案，掣出铁棒，一路打出南天门，回到花果山。独角鬼王献上赭黄袍，劝他索性做个“齐天大圣”。
sections.headingEn: Heaven's first office: Keeper of the Horses
sections.headingZh: 天庭的第一份官职：弼马温

sections.bodyEn: Wukong raised a banner reading 'Great Sage Equal to Heaven'. The Jade Emperor sent Heavenly King Li and his son Nezha with heaven's soldiers. The vanguard, the Mighty Spirit, had his axe-handle snapped by one blow; Nezha took three heads and six arms, but Wukong did the same, sent a hair-double to fight, and struck Nezha from behind. Venus advised granting the empty title Great Sage Equal to Heaven, with no salary, to quiet the monkey's heart. A mansion was built for him beside the Peach Garden, complete with Offices of Peace and Serenity, and Wukong settled happily in heaven.
sections.bodyZh: 悟空在洞门外竖起一面大旗，上书“齐天大圣”四个大字。玉帝派托塔李天王和哪吒三太子带领天兵下界捉拿。先锋巨灵神挥着宣花斧上阵，被悟空一棒打断斧柄，败回营中。哪吒变出三头六臂，持六般兵器来战，悟空也变三头六臂，又拔一根毫毛变作本相迎敌，真身绕到背后，一棒打中哪吒的左臂，哪吒负痛败走。李天王只好收兵回奏。太白金星又出主意：不如就封他个空衔“齐天大圣”，有官无禄，养在天地之间，收他的邪心。玉帝依从，在蟠桃园右首给他盖了一座齐天大圣府，府里还设了安静司、宁神司两个衙门。悟空这才欢天喜地，在天上住了下来。

sections.bodyEn: With nothing to do, the Great Sage wandered heaven befriending stars. To keep him occupied the Jade Emperor put him in charge of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, whose 3,600 trees ripened every three, six and nine thousand years, granting immortality, eternal youth and a life as long as heaven and earth. Secretly delighted, he sent his attendants away and gorged on the ripest fruit. When seven fairy maidens came to pick peaches for the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet, they woke him from a nap in the treetops — and he learned that he had not been invited.
sections.bodyZh: 大圣在天上无事可做，今天东游，明天西荡，和众星宿称兄道弟。许旌阳真人担心他闲中生事，玉帝便派他去管理蟠桃园。土地告诉他：园里共有三千六百株桃树——前面一千二百株，三千年一熟，人吃了成仙了道；中间一千二百株，六千年一熟，人吃了霞举飞升、长生不老；后面一千二百株，九千年一熟，人吃了与天地齐寿、日月同庚。大圣听了暗暗高兴，从此常常支开土地和力士，自己脱下冠服爬上大树，拣那熟透的大桃子吃个饱。有一天，王母娘娘要开蟠桃盛会，派七位仙女提着花篮来园中摘桃。大圣正变成二寸长的小人在树梢上睡觉，被惊醒后问仙女都请了谁，仙女一一说来，却没有他。

sections.bodyEn: Freezing the fairies with an immobilising spell, the Great Sage flew to the Jade Pool, put the wine-makers to sleep with sleep-insects made from his hairs and drank himself senseless. Staggering the wrong way, he wandered into Laozi's Tushita Palace and ate the five gourds of finished elixir pills as if they were roasted beans. Sobering in alarm, he fled home. The Jade Emperor sent the Four Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, Nezha, the twenty-eight lunar mansions and the nine planets with a hundred thousand soldiers and eighteen nets around the mountain, yet the Great Sage held them off until nightfall.
sections.bodyZh: 大圣用定身法把七位仙女定在树下，驾云直奔瑶池。宴席已经摆好，他拔毫毛变出瞌睡虫，叫造酒的力士都睡着了，自己端起玉液琼浆喝了个酩酊大醉。醉醺醺的他走错了路，闯进太上老君的兜率宫，宫中无人，只见丹房里摆着五个葫芦，装满炼好的金丹。他想：这是仙家至宝，我且尝尝。于是把葫芦里的金丹倒出来，像吃炒豆一样全吃了。酒醒之后，他知道闯了大祸，连忙逃出西天门，回到花果山。玉帝大怒，派四大天王、李天王、哪吒，率领二十八宿、九曜星官、十二元辰等十万天兵，布下十八架天罗地网围住花果山。大圣带着群猴迎战，一连打败九曜星和四大天王，到天黑也没有被捉住。
sections.headingEn: Stolen wine, stolen elixir and heaven's army

sections.bodyEn: Guanyin recommended the Jade Emperor's nephew, the Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang. With his six sworn brothers and his celestial hound, Erlang fought the Great Sage for over three hundred rounds. When the monkeys scattered, the Great Sage fled through transformation after transformation — sparrow, cormorant, fish, water snake, bustard — and Erlang matched each as hawk, crane, osprey and grey crane. Disguised as a temple, the monkey could not hide his tail and stood it up behind as a flagpole, which gave him away. At last Laozi dropped his Diamond Snare on his head, the hound bit his leg, and he was seized.
sections.bodyZh: 观音菩萨赴蟠桃会，听说此事，先派徒弟惠岸行者下界交战，也败了回来。观音便向玉帝推荐玉帝的外甥——住在灌江口的显圣二郎真君。二郎神带着梅山六兄弟和哮天犬来到花果山，和大圣大战三百余回合，不分胜负，各自变成万丈高的法身相斗。猴群溃散，大圣心慌，收了法相变成一只麻雀飞上树梢；二郎就变成饿鹰去扑他。大圣变成大鹚老冲天飞去，二郎变成海鹤追赶；他变鱼钻进水里，二郎变鱼鹰候着；他变水蛇，二郎变灰鹤；他变成一只低贱的花鸨，二郎不屑追，用弹弓把他打落。大圣滚到山崖下又变成一座土地庙，嘴变庙门，牙变门扇，舌头变菩萨，尾巴没处放，竖在后面变成一根旗杆，被二郎一眼识破。最后太上老君在云端丢下金刚琢，正打在大圣头上，哮天犬扑上来咬住他的腿，大圣才被众神按倒擒住。

sections.bodyEn: Bound at the execution terrace, the Great Sage could not be hurt by sword, axe, fire or thunder: the peaches, wine and elixir had made his body adamantine. Laozi had him placed in his Eight Trigrams furnace to be refined for forty-nine days. Hiding under the trigram of wind, where there is no fire, he was only smoked — which reddened his eyes into 'fiery golden eyes'. When the furnace was opened he sprang out, kicked it over so that its burning bricks fell to earth, and fought his way to the Hall of Divine Mists, where only the officer Wang Lingguan stood against him.
sections.bodyZh: 大圣被押到斩妖台，绑在降妖柱上。天兵刀砍斧剁、枪刺剑刳，火部众神放火烧、雷部众神用雷劈，竟伤不了他一根毫毛。太上老君说：这猴子吃了蟠桃、喝了御酒，又盗吃了我的金丹，炼成了金刚之躯。不如交给我，放进八卦炉里，用文武火锻炼，炼出我的丹来，他的身体自然化为灰烬。大圣被推进八卦炉，他钻进巽宫位下——巽是风，有风就没有火，只是被烟熏红了眼睛，从此有了一双“火眼金睛”。四十九天后，老君开炉取丹，大圣忽地跳了出来，一脚蹬倒八卦炉，炉砖带着火掉落凡间。他掏出金箍棒，从兜率宫一路打到灵霄殿外，九曜星闭门闭户，四天王无影无踪，只有王灵官举着金鞭拦住了他。
sections.headingEn: Fiery golden eyes in the Eight Trigrams furnace

sections.bodyEn: Surrounded by Wang Lingguan and thirty-six thunder generals, the Great Sage fought them off with three heads, six arms and three staffs, until the Jade Emperor sent to the West for Rulai. Asked what right he had to the throne, the Great Sage replied that emperors take turns — next year it would be his. Rulai offered a wager: if he could somersault out of Rulai's right palm, the Jade Emperor would yield heaven; if not, he must return below. Scoffing that his somersault covered 108,000 li, the Great Sage leapt — and came to five flesh-pink pillars he took to be the edge of the sky.
sections.bodyZh: 王灵官和三十六员雷将把大圣团团围住，大圣变出三头六臂，把金箍棒幌一幌变成三根，六只手使开，打得雷将们近不了身。玉帝只好派游弈灵官和翊圣真君到西方去请如来佛祖。如来来到灵霄殿外，叫雷将停手，问大圣：你有什么本事，敢夺玉帝的尊位？大圣说：“皇帝轮流做，明年到我家”，只要玉帝把天宫让给他就罢了。如来笑道：我和你打个赌——你若一个筋斗翻得出我的右手掌，就算你赢，请玉帝到西方居住，天宫让给你；若翻不出去，你就回下界做妖，再修几劫来争。大圣暗笑：我一个筋斗十万八千里，他的手掌不满一尺，怎么跳不出去？他跳上佛掌，一个筋斗云不见踪影，只见天边立着五根肉红柱子，便以为到了天的尽头。

sections.bodyEn: To prove his journey he made a brush from a hair, wrote 'The Great Sage Equal to Heaven was here' on the middle pillar, and relieved himself at the foot of the first. Somersaulting back, he demanded the throne. Rulai showed him the words written on his own middle finger and the smell of monkey urine at the base of his thumb. Before the monkey could leap again, Rulai pushed him out of the Western Gate and turned his five fingers into the five joined peaks of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth — the Mountain of Five Elements — sealed with a golden six-syllable charm. The local god was to feed him iron pellets and molten copper until, five hundred years later, someone would come to free him.
sections.bodyZh: 大圣心想：我到了这里，回去跟如来做个凭证。他拔一根毫毛变出一支浓墨双毫笔，在中间那根柱子上写下一行大字：“齐天大圣到此一游”。写完收了毫毛，又不庄重地在第一根柱子下撒了一泡猴尿，然后翻转筋斗回到原处，对如来说：我已经去了又回来了，你叫玉帝让出天宫吧！如来骂道：你这尿精猴子，你正好不曾离开我的手掌！你低头看看。大圣一看，如来右手中指上写着“齐天大圣到此一游”，大拇指根下还有一股猴尿的臊气。他大吃一惊，正要再跳，被如来翻掌一扑，推出西天门外，五根手指化作金、木、水、火、土五座相连的大山，叫作“五行山”，把他压在山下。众神在天宫摆了“安天大会”答谢如来。如来又取出写着“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽”六个金字的帖子，贴在山顶，并嘱咐当地的土地神：他饿了就给他吃铁丸子，渴了就给他喝熔化的铜汁。等他的灾难满了，自然会有人来救他。——这一压，就是五百年。
sections.headingEn: Under the Mountain of Five Elements
sections.uncertaintyNote: “五百年”的时间与后来唐僧解救的情节见于第八回之后，本篇只讲到被压为止。

versions.witnessScope: 维基文库所收《西游记》第一至七回

stories.canonicalTitle: Journey to the West: how the pilgrimage began
stories.editorialNote: 明代小说属于后世文学接受层。第九回陈光蕊、江流儿的故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回；本站依维基文库所收版本讲述，并在该章注明。
stories.summaryEn: After Havoc in Heaven, the Buddha resolves to send his scriptures east, and Guanyin travels to find a pilgrim, recruiting on the way the future disciples Sha Wujing, Zhu Bajie, the jade dragon prince and the Monkey King under the mountain. In Chang'an the orphan Jiangliu grows up to be the monk Xuanzang; the Jing River dragon king breaks heaven's decree to win a bet and is beheaded in Wei Zheng's dream; Emperor Taizong visits the underworld and returns to hold a great mass for the dead. Guanyin appears at the mass, Xuanzang volunteers to fetch the scriptures, and he leaves with a pinch of home soil in his wine.
stories.summaryZh: 大闹天宫之后，如来要把三藏真经传到东土，观音菩萨领命东行，一路上为未来的取经人点化了沙和尚、猪刚鬣、玉龙三太子和五行山下的孙悟空。长安这边，江流儿陈玄奘历尽身世之苦长大成僧；泾河龙王为了赌气私改雨数，被魏征梦中斩首，冤魂纠缠唐太宗，太宗魂游地府后还阳，决定举办水陆大会。观音在大会上显圣，说西天有大乘真经，玄奘领命成为“三藏”，带着一捻故乡土踏上西行之路。
stories.titleZh: 西游记 · 取经缘起：从灵山到长安

claims.statement: At the Ullambana feast the Buddha of the novel offers three baskets of scripture (35 works, 15,144 scrolls) for the eastern land and asks for a pilgrim to fetch them; Guanyin volunteers to find one.
The Buddha gives Guanyin a brocade cassock, a nine-ringed staff and three fillets with spells for disciples who disobey; she sets out east with Huian (Muzha).

Guanyin enlists the banished Curtain-Raising General at the Flowing Sands River as Sha Wujing and the banished Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy at Fuling Mountain as Zhu Wuneng, to wait for the pilgrim.
Guanyin obtains a pardon for the condemned jade dragon prince to serve as the pilgrim's mount and promises Sun Wukong release if he becomes the pilgrim's disciple.

In the novel's ninth chapter Tang Sanzang's father Chen Guangrui wins the examination, marries Yin Wenjiao through an embroidered ball and releases a blinking golden carp into the Hong River on his way to his post.
The boatman Liu Hong murders Chen Guangrui at the Hong River crossing and takes his post and his wife; the river's dragon king, the carp he had freed, preserves his body with a pearl.

As a newborn, Tang Sanzang is set adrift on a plank with his mother's letter in blood and the tip of his left little toe bitten off as a mark; Abbot Faming of Jinshan Monastery raises him as Jiangliu.

Ordained as Xuanzang at eighteen, he learns his origin from the blood letter, finds his mother, heals his blind grandmother, and his grandfather's troops capture Liu Hong; Chen Guangrui is restored to life by the river's dragon king.

Told by a yaksha that the fortune-teller Yuan Shoucheng guides the fisherman Zhang Shao's nets every day, the Dragon King of the Jing River goes into Chang'an disguised as a white-robed scholar to test him.
After betting against Yuan Shoucheng's forecast and then receiving a decree that matches it exactly, the Jing River dragon king delays the rain and withholds three inches and eight drops to win.
Though Emperor Taizong keeps Wei Zheng at chess to save him, the Jing River dragon king is beheaded at noon by Wei Zheng in a dream, and his head falls from the sky.

In the novel the beheaded dragon's ghost haunts Emperor Taizong; Qin Shubao and Yuchi Jingde guard his gate and become the door gods, and Taizong dies carrying Wei Zheng's letter to the underworld judge Cui Jue.

In the novel's underworld the judge Cui Jue changes Taizong's term in the register from the thirteenth to the thirty-third year; the emperor pays the wronged ghosts with a borrowed treasury, promises a mass for the dead and returns to life.

In the novel Liu Quan dies to deliver Taizong's melons to the underworld; his dead wife Li Cuilian returns in the body of the emperor's sister, and the emperor builds the Xiangguo Monastery for Xiang Liang.
Disguised as a scabby monk, Guanyin offers the Buddha's cassock and staff for sale in Chang'an and then gives them free to Emperor Taizong for Xuanzang, chosen to lead the great mass for the dead.
At the great mass Guanyin interrupts Xuanzang's preaching of the Lesser Vehicle, announces the Great Vehicle scriptures at Thunderclap Monastery in the west and reveals her true form on a cloud.
Xuanzang volunteers to fetch the scriptures; Emperor Taizong makes him his sworn brother, names him Sanzang and sends him west with a pinch of home soil in his wine.

entities.canonicalName: Dragon King of the Jing River

events.summaryEn: Five hundred years after pinning Sun Wukong under the Mountain of Five Elements, the Buddha held the Ullambana feast on Spirit Mountain and described the four continents: the people of the southern continent of Jambudvīpa were greedy, lustful and quarrelsome, a sea of strife.
events.summaryZh: 如来把孙悟空压在五行山下以后，回到西天灵山雷音宝刹，不知不觉过了五百年。
events.titleEn: Three baskets of scripture on Spirit Mountain

events.summaryEn: The delighted Buddha told Guanyin to travel half on cloud and half on mist, noting the distances for the pilgrim, and had Ānanda and Kāśyapa bring five treasures: a brocade cassock and a nine-ringed staff for the pilgrim — whoever wore the cassock would escape rebirth, whoever held the staff would escape poison — and three fillets with the spells Gold, Tight and Prohibition.
events.summaryZh: 如来非常高兴，说：别人去不得，须是观音尊者，神通广大，才可以去。
events.titleEn: Five treasures and the road east

events.summaryEn: The demon said he had been the Curtain-Raising General who attended the imperial carriage; for breaking a crystal cup at the Peach Banquet he was flogged eight hundred times, banished and pierced by a flying sword every seven days, so hunger drove him to eat travellers.
events.summaryZh: 那妖魔叩头说：菩萨恕罪！
events.titleEn: The Flowing Sands River and Fuling Mountain

events.summaryEn: Further east Guanyin found a jade dragon hanging in the sky: the son of the Dragon King of the Western Sea, condemned for burning a pearl in his father's hall.
events.summaryZh: 菩萨和木叉继续东行，正走着，忽然看见半空中吊着一条玉龙，正在叫苦。
events.titleEn: The dragon in the air and the monkey under the mountain
events.titleZh: 空中的玉龙与山下的猴王

events.summaryEn: Guanyin reached Chang'an and lodged in the earth-god's shrine disguised as a scabby monk.
events.summaryZh: 菩萨离开五行山，一路来到大唐国都长安。
events.titleEn: The top scholar, the embroidered ball and the golden carp
events.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。

events.summaryEn: At the Hong River crossing the boatmen Liu Hong and Li Biao ferried them, and Liu Hong coveted the young wife.
events.summaryZh: 夫妻俩带着家僮来到洪江渡口，船夫刘洪、李彪撑船过来迎接。
events.titleEn: Murder at the Hong River crossing
events.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。

events.summaryEn: In the Jiangzhou yamen Wenjiao bore a son.
events.summaryZh: 殷小姐在江州衙门里痛恨刘洪，恨不得食其肉、寝其皮，只因身怀有孕，未知男女，只得勉强忍耐。
events.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。

events.summaryEn: At eighteen Jiangliu was ordained as Xuanzang.
events.summaryZh: 光阴似箭，江流长到十八岁，长老给他剃度出家，取法名玄奘，他一心参禅，持斋把素。
events.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回；有的版本还写到殷小姐最后从容自尽，本节不展开。

events.summaryEn: Outside Chang'an, by the Jing River, the fisherman Zhang Shao and the woodcutter Li Ding, tipsy and trading verses, argued about whose trade was safer.
events.summaryZh: 长安城外的泾河岸边，住着两个不登科的贤人：一个是渔翁，名叫张稍；一个是樵子，名叫李定。
events.titleEn: A fisherman, a woodcutter and a fortune-teller

events.summaryEn: The dragon king asked about tomorrow's weather.
events.summaryZh: 龙王挤进卦铺，见袁守诚相貌稀奇、仪容秀丽，便请他占卜一课。

events.summaryEn: Yuan Shoucheng laughed at the wrecked booth: he knew the scholar was the Jing River dragon king, who by changing heaven's decree had earned execution at a quarter past noon tomorrow — and the executioner would be Chief Minister Wei Zheng.
events.summaryZh: 袁守诚坐在那里纹丝不动，龙王又抡起门板就打，骂道：你这妄言祸福的妖人，擅惑众心的泼汉！

events.summaryEn: From then on the dragon's ghost came at night carrying its head, crying to Taizong to give back its life and come argue before the judges of the dead; once a heavenly lady waved a willow sprig and drove it off — Guanyin protecting him unseen.
events.summaryZh: 太宗见了龙头，心中又惊又悔，回宫后闷闷不乐。
events.titleEn: The door gods and the emperor's death

events.summaryEn: Taizong's soul was received by the judge Cui Jue, who read Wei Zheng's letter.
events.summaryZh: 太宗的魂魄出了五凤楼，恍恍惚惚，被引到一处荒郊，判官崔珏前来迎接，跪在路旁说：微臣有失远迎。

events.summaryEn: Restored to life, Taizong freed the prisoners and sought someone to take melons to the Ten Kings as he had promised.
events.summaryZh: 太宗还阳以后，大赦天下，把死囚都放回家中与父母妻子团聚，又出榜招贤，要找人把南瓜送到阴司去，答谢十代阎王——那是他在阴间答应过的。

events.summaryEn: To keep his underworld promise, Taizong summoned the eminent monks and the court recommended Xuanzang, a vegetarian from birth with a famous pedigree and mastery of the sutras; the emperor made him chief monk of the realm, with the altar at Huasheng Monastery.
events.summaryZh: 太宗要兑现在阴司许下的诺言，召集天下高僧，要选一位有德行的大阐都僧纲，在化生寺开设水陆大会。

events.summaryEn: On the seventh day of the mass, while Xuanzang preached from the high altar before the emperor, the scabby monk struck the altar and asked whether he could only teach the Lesser Vehicle.
events.summaryZh: 水陆大会开到第七天，太宗亲自摆驾，带领文武百官到化生寺拈香。

events.summaryEn: Xuanzang knelt and volunteered.
events.summaryZh: 话音刚落，玄奘从旁边闪出，走上前来，拜伏在地：贫僧不才，愿效犬马之劳，与陛下求取真经，祈保我王江山永固。

versions.labelEn: Journey to the West, chapters 8–12 (long retelling)
versions.labelZh: 《西游记》第八至十二回（长篇讲述）
versions.narrativeScope: 如来造经、观音东行收徒、陈光蕊与江流儿、泾河龙王与魏征斩龙、太宗游地府、刘全进瓜、水陆大会与玄奘西行
versions.rightsNote: 小说原文属公共领域；本站发布的是按回目顺序的独立白话讲述。

sections.bodyEn: Five hundred years after pinning Sun Wukong under the Mountain of Five Elements, the Buddha held the Ullambana feast on Spirit Mountain and described the four continents: the people of the southern continent of Jambudvīpa were greedy, lustful and quarrelsome, a sea of strife. He had three baskets of true scripture — one on heaven, one on earth, one to save the dead — thirty-five works in 15,144 scrolls, that could turn people to the good. But if he simply sent them east, the foolish would slander them. Someone must find a faithful person in the east who would cross a thousand mountains to fetch them himself. Guanyin of Potalaka stepped forward and offered to go.
sections.bodyZh: 如来把孙悟空压在五行山下以后，回到西天灵山雷音宝刹，不知不觉过了五百年。这一年七月十五，如来叫人摆开百宝异果，举行盂兰盆会，对聚集而来的诸佛、菩萨、罗汉、揭谛、比丘说：我观看天下四大部洲，众生善恶，各方不一。东胜神洲的人敬天礼地，心爽气平；北俱芦洲的人虽然好杀生，却只为糊口度日，性情拙笨，也不多作践；西牛贺洲的人不贪不杀，养气潜灵，虽然没有上真，人人都能长寿；只有南赡部洲的人贪淫乐祸，多杀多争，正是口舌凶场、是非恶海。众人听得连连叹息。如来接着说：我如今有三藏真经，可以劝人为善。一藏是法，谈天；一藏是论，说地；一藏是经，度鬼。三藏共计三十五部，一万五千一百四十四卷，是修真之经，正善之门。凡天下四大部洲的天文、地理、人物、鸟兽、花木、器用、人事，无所不载。我本想把它们直接送上东土，可是那方众生愚蠢，必定会毁谤真言，不识我法门的要旨，怠慢了瑜伽的正宗。怎样才能找到一位法力高强的神，到东土去寻一个善信之人，叫他苦历千山，远经万水，亲自到我这里来求取真经，永传东土，劝化众生呢？话音刚落，观音菩萨走上莲台，向佛三匝礼拜，说：弟子不才，愿到东土去寻一个取经人。众佛抬头一看，只见那菩萨理圆四德，智满金身，正是南海普陀落伽山救苦救难的大慈大悲观世音。
sections.headingEn: Three baskets of scripture on Spirit Mountain

sections.bodyEn: The delighted Buddha told Guanyin to travel half on cloud and half on mist, noting the distances for the pilgrim, and had Ānanda and Kāśyapa bring five treasures: a brocade cassock and a nine-ringed staff for the pilgrim — whoever wore the cassock would escape rebirth, whoever held the staff would escape poison — and three fillets with the spells Gold, Tight and Prohibition. A powerful demon who agreed to reform was to become the pilgrim's disciple; if he disobeyed, the fillet would take root on his head and the spell would make it split with pain. Guanyin set out with Huian, Prince Muzha, armed with an iron rod. At the Flowing Sands River, where not even a goose feather floats, a sallow demon with a necklace of nine skulls sprang at her; he fought Muzha to a standstill, then knelt on hearing Guanyin's name.
sections.bodyZh: 如来非常高兴，说：别人去不得，须是观音尊者，神通广大，才可以去。又嘱咐她：这一去，不许在霄汉中行走，要半云半雾，一路看清山水，牢记路程的远近，好叮咛那取经的人。只是那取经人恐怕难行，我给你五件宝贝。说着命阿傩、迦叶取出一件锦襕异宝袈裟、一根九环锡杖，说：这袈裟和锡杖，送给那取经人亲自使用。他若是坚心来这里，穿上我的袈裟，免堕轮回；拿着我的锡杖，不遭毒害。又取出三个箍儿，说：这宝贝名叫“紧箍儿”，虽然一样三个，用法各不相同。我有“金、紧、禁”的咒语三篇。路上要是遇到神通广大的妖魔，你就劝他学好，跟那取经人做个徒弟。他要是不服使唤，就把这箍儿给他戴在头上，自然见肉生根；各依所用的咒语念一念，眼胀头痛，脑门皆裂，管教他入我门来。观音拜谢领了宝贝，带着徒弟惠岸行者——也就是托塔李天王的二太子木叉——离开灵山。惠岸使一条浑铁棍，在前面开路保护。师徒二人半云半雾，一路东行，走到弱水三千的流沙河边，只见河水浑浑，波涛汹涌，鹅毛也飘不起，芦花也定底沉。忽然河中泼剌一声，跳出一个妖魔：青不青，黑不黑，晦气色脸；长不长，短不短，赤脚筋躯；脖子上挂着九个骷髅，手里拿一根宝杖，直扑菩萨。木叉举棍拦住，两人在河边大战了几十个回合，不分胜负。妖魔停住手问：你是哪里来的和尚，敢和我对敌？木叉说：我是托塔天王二太子木叉惠岸行者，保护我师父往东土寻取经人。那妖魔一听“观音菩萨”四个字，连忙收了宝杖，扔下兵器跪在地上。
sections.headingEn: Five treasures and the road east

sections.bodyEn: The demon said he had been the Curtain-Raising General who attended the imperial carriage; for breaking a crystal cup at the Peach Banquet he was flogged eight hundred times, banished and pierced by a flying sword every seven days, so hunger drove him to eat travellers. Nine pilgrims' skulls would not sink, so he strung them on a cord. Guanyin promised to stop the sword if he served the pilgrim, told him to keep the skulls for later use, and named him Sha Wujing. At Fuling Mountain a long-snouted monster with a nine-toothed rake attacked: the former Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy, banished for molesting the moon goddess while drunk and reborn by mistake in a sow's womb, who had married into the Cloud-Ladder Cave and lived by eating people. 'Shall I live on the wind?' he asked; Guanyin assured him a good vow would be provided for. Named Zhu Wuneng, he gave up meat to wait.
sections.bodyZh: 那妖魔叩头说：菩萨恕罪！我不是别的妖邪，我是灵霄殿下侍銮舆的卷帘大将。只因在蟠桃会上失手打碎了一只玻璃盏，玉帝把我打了八百下，贬到下界，变成这副模样，又叫我每七天被飞剑穿胸肋一百多下，所以我在这里受苦。饥寒难忍，三两天就出波涛找个行人吃。没想到今天冲撞了大慈菩萨。菩萨说：你在天上有罪，贬下来还这样伤生，真是罪上加罪。我奉佛旨上东土寻取经人，你何不入我门来，皈依善果，跟那取经人做个徒弟，上西天拜佛求经？我叫飞剑不来穿你，那时功成免罪，复你本职。妖魔说：我愿皈正果。又说：我在这里吃人无数，前后有几次取经人来，都被我吃了。凡是被吃的人头，我都抛在流沙里，全都沉了；只有九个取经人的骷髅，浮在水面，再也不沉，我觉得稀奇，就用索子穿起来，闲时拿来玩耍。菩萨说：这是取经人的骷髅，你可以挂在颈上，等取经人来，自有用处。于是给他摩顶受戒，指沙为姓，取名沙悟净。菩萨又往东走，来到福陵山，一股妖气冲天。忽然一个长嘴大耳的妖怪，举着一把九齿钉钯扑来。原来他是天河里的天蓬元帅，因为在蟠桃会上喝醉了酒，调戏嫦娥，被玉帝打了二千锤，贬下凡尘，投胎时错投了母猪的胎，变成这副嘴脸。他在云栈洞里招赘给卵二姐，卵二姐死后，洞里的家当都归了他，他就靠吃人度日。菩萨劝他：古人说，若要有前程，莫做没前程。你跟随取经人往西天去，将功折罪。妖怪说：前程，前程！要依你，叫我喝西北风吗？菩萨说：人有善愿，天必从之，自有吃食的地方。妖怪这才答应，菩萨给他取名猪悟能。他从此断了五荤三厌，专心等着取经人。
sections.headingEn: The Flowing Sands River and Fuling Mountain

sections.bodyEn: Further east Guanyin found a jade dragon hanging in the sky: the son of the Dragon King of the Western Sea, condemned for burning a pearl in his father's hall. She went to the Southern Gate, obtained his pardon from the Jade Emperor and set him in a deep gorge to wait as the pilgrim's horse. At the Mountain of Five Elements Sun Wukong called from his stone box: for five hundred years the local gods had fed him iron pellets and molten copper. He begged for release and promised to reform. Guanyin said a pilgrim from the Tang would free him if he became his disciple, and offered him a religious name — but he already had one, Wukong, and she was pleased that it matched the other two disciples' 'Wu' names.
sections.bodyZh: 菩萨和木叉继续东行，正走着，忽然看见半空中吊着一条玉龙，正在叫苦。菩萨近前问道：你是哪里的龙，在这里受罪？那龙说：我是西海龙王敖闰的儿子，因为纵火烧了殿上的明珠，父王告我忤逆，天庭判了死罪，不日就要遭诛，求菩萨救我。菩萨当即上了南天门，求见玉帝：我奉佛旨上东土寻取经人，路上遇见这孽龙，特来奏请饶他性命，赐给我，叫他给取经人做个脚力。玉帝准奏，派天将解开玉龙交给菩萨。菩萨把他送到一处深涧，嘱咐他：等取经人来了，你变作白马，上西方立功。玉龙领命藏身去了。菩萨又往前走，远远望见万道金光、千条瑞气，原来已经到了五行山——这正是当年如来压住齐天大圣的地方。山下石匣里忽然有人高叫：是哪个在山上吟诗，揭我的短？菩萨走下山来看，原来是孙悟空，被压在石匣之中，口能言，身不能动。悟空认出了菩萨，叫道：菩萨，我在这里度日如年，没一个相知的来看我。你从哪里来？菩萨说：我奉佛旨，上东土寻取经人，路过这里，特来看你。悟空说：如来哄了我，把我压在此山，五百多年了，不能展挣。土地神看守着我，我饿了给我吃铁丸子，渴了给我喝溶化的铜汁。万望菩萨方便一二，救我老孙一救！菩萨说：你这猴子罪业弥深，救你出来，恐你又生祸害。悟空说：我已知悔了，但愿大慈悲指条门路，情愿修行。菩萨大喜，说：我到东土大唐国寻一个取经的人来，叫他救你。你可跟他做个徒弟，秉教伽持，入我佛门，再修正果。悟空连声说：愿去！愿去！菩萨说：既有善果，我与你起个法名。悟空说：我已有名了，叫做孙悟空。菩萨高兴地说：我前面也收了两个人，名字都是“悟”字排行，你也叫“悟”，正合着他们，甚好！
sections.headingEn: The dragon in the air and the monkey under the mountain
sections.headingZh: 空中的玉龙与山下的猴王

sections.bodyEn: Guanyin reached Chang'an and lodged in the earth-god's shrine disguised as a scabby monk. That year Chen E, styled Guangrui, of Haizhou, came first in the palace examination. Riding through the streets, he passed the mansion of Chief Minister Yin Kaishan, whose daughter Wenjiao was choosing a husband by throwing an embroidered ball from a decorated tower; it struck his hat, and they married that day. Appointed governor of Jiangzhou, he set out with his wife and his mother; at the Wanhua inn his mother fell ill. Seeing a fisherman selling a golden carp whose eyes kept blinking, Guangrui thought it no ordinary fish, bought it and released it into the Hong River. Pressed for time, he left his mother at the inn to recover and went on with his wife.
sections.bodyZh: 菩萨离开五行山，一路来到大唐国都长安。她和木叉变作两个疥癞游僧，住进城里的土地庙，暗中访求善人。那时是贞观十三年，长安城里正开科取士。海州有个读书人，姓陈名萼，字光蕊，告别母亲张氏，进京赶考。三场考完，唐王亲自出题，光蕊考中了第一名状元，跨马游街三日。游到丞相殷开山的府门前，殷丞相的女儿温娇——小名满堂娇——还没有婚配，正在彩楼上抛绣球选婿。她看见光蕊人才出众，又知道他是新科状元，心中十分欢喜，便把绣球抛下，恰好打中光蕊的乌纱帽。楼上楼下顿时笙箫齐奏，丫鬟们把光蕊迎进府中，两人当天就拜堂成亲。第二天，唐王任命光蕊为江州州主，催他即刻上任。光蕊带着妻子回到海州，接上母亲一同赴任。走到洪州地界的万花店，母亲张氏忽然病倒了。光蕊在店门前，看见一个渔人提着一尾金色的鲤鱼叫卖，那鱼的眼睛一闪一闪地眨动。光蕊说：我听说鱼蛇眨眼，必定不是等闲之物。就花一贯钱把鱼买下，送到洪江边放生了。回店里对母亲说起，母亲说：放生好事，我心里也欢喜。因为上任的日期催得紧，光蕊只得把母亲留在店中养病，付了房钱，约好秋凉时再来接她，自己带着妻子先走了。
sections.headingEn: The top scholar, the embroidered ball and the golden carp
sections.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。

sections.bodyEn: At the Hong River crossing the boatmen Liu Hong and Li Biao ferried them, and Liu Hong coveted the young wife. At midnight they rowed to a lonely place, killed the servant, struck Chen Guangrui dead and threw him in the river. When Wenjiao tried to drown herself, Liu Hong seized her and threatened her; pregnant, she submitted, hoping one day to avenge her husband. Liu Hong put on Guangrui's robes, took his letter of appointment and went to Jiangzhou as governor in his name. The body sank to the river bed, where the Hong River dragon king recognised his saviour — he himself had been the golden carp. He fetched Guangrui's soul from the local city god, put a face-preserving pearl in his mouth and kept him in the water palace as an officer, to await revenge and return.
sections.bodyZh: 夫妻俩带着家僮来到洪江渡口，船夫刘洪、李彪撑船过来迎接。也是光蕊前世合当有这场灾难，撞着这对冤家。刘洪一眼看见殷小姐面如满月、眼似秋波，顿起歹心，和李彪商量好，把船撑到了没有人烟的地方。等到夜深三更，他们先把家僮打死，又把陈光蕊打死，尸首推进了江里。殷小姐见丈夫被害，也要跳江寻死，刘洪一把抱住她说：你要是从了我，万事皆休；要是不从，一刀两断！殷小姐想到自己腹中已有身孕，留得性命或许还能为丈夫报仇，只得权且顺从。刘洪穿上光蕊的衣冠，拿着他的官凭，带着殷小姐到江州冒名上任去了。光蕊的尸首沉在江底，动也不动，被巡江的夜叉看见，飞报龙王。龙王叫人把尸首抬来一看，说：这人正是救我性命的恩人，怎么被人谋死了？原来前几天那尾金色鲤鱼，就是洪江龙王变化出游，被渔人捉住，若不是光蕊买下放生，早已没命了。龙王说：常言道，恩将恩报。我今天须当救他性命，以报前日之恩。他写了一道牒文，差夜叉送到洪州城隍土地处，要来了光蕊的魂魄；又取出一颗定颜珠，放进光蕊口中，保住他的尸身不坏，日后好还魂报仇。龙王对光蕊的魂魄说：你暂且在我水府中做个都领，等将来再还阳。光蕊叩头拜谢，就在水府中住了下来。
sections.headingEn: Murder at the Hong River crossing
sections.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。

sections.bodyEn: In the Jiangzhou yamen Wenjiao bore a son. A voice in her ear said it was the Star of the South Pole, sent by Guanyin: the child would become famous, his father had been saved by the dragon king, and she must protect him from Liu Hong. Liu Hong wanted the child drowned; when he was called away on urgent business, she decided the river was safer. She bit her finger and wrote a letter in blood with his parents' names and story, bit off the tip of his left little toe as a mark, wrapped him in her shirt, tied him to a floating plank with the letter on his breast and pushed him into the river. The plank drifted to the foot of Jinshan Monastery, where Abbot Faming heard the crying, took him in and named him Jiangliu, 'River Float', keeping the letter safe.
sections.bodyZh: 殷小姐在江州衙门里痛恨刘洪，恨不得食其肉、寝其皮，只因身怀有孕，未知男女，只得勉强忍耐。转眼到了临盆的日子，她在衙中生下一个男孩。正抱着孩子哭泣，忽然听见耳边有人叮嘱：满堂娇，听我叮嘱。我是南极星君，奉观音菩萨法旨，特送这孩子与你，异日声名远大，非比等闲。刘贼若回来，必定要害这孩子，你可用心保护。你丈夫已经得了龙王相救，日后夫妻相会，子母团圆，雪冤报仇有日。说完便不见了。不久刘洪回来，一见孩子，果然要把他淹死。殷小姐推说今天天色已晚，容到明日再抛到江中去。第二天，刘洪恰好有紧急公事出门，殷小姐暗想：这孩子留在这里，刘贼回来必定害他性命，不如早早抛到江中，听天由命。倘若皇天见怜，有人救去收养，将来还能相逢。她又怕日后难以相认，就咬破手指，写下一纸血书，把孩子父母的姓名、跟脚原由备细写明；又把孩子左脚上的一个小指用口咬下，作为记号。她取出一件贴身的汗衫，把孩子包好，趁着衙内无人，抱到江边。正要把孩子抛下，忽见江岸边漂来一片木板，她便朝天拜祷，把孩子安在木板上，用带子缚住，血书系在胸前，推入江中，任他漂流而去，自己含着眼泪回衙去了。那木板顺着江水一直流到镇江金山寺脚下停住。金山寺的长老叫做法明和尚，修真悟道，已得无生妙诀。他正在打坐，忽然听见江边有小儿啼哭，循声出去一看，见木板上缚着一个婴儿，就把他抱回寺中，取名江流，托人抚养，血书紧紧收藏起来。
sections.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。

sections.bodyEn: At eighteen Jiangliu was ordained as Xuanzang. When a monk he had bested in debate sneered that he did not know his own parents' names, Faming gave him the blood letter, and he vowed revenge. Begging at the Jiangzhou yamen, he met his mother, who recognised him by the missing toe. She sent him to find his grandmother at the Wanhua inn — now blind from weeping and begging in the street; when Xuanzang licked her eyes and prayed, her sight returned — and then to her father in Chang'an. Minister Yin led sixty thousand imperial troops to Jiangzhou and captured Liu Hong and Li Biao; Liu Hong's heart and liver were offered at the crossing where he had killed Guangrui. The dragon king returned the body, Guangrui stretched and woke, and the family was reunited; Xuanzang returned to Hongfu Monastery.
sections.bodyZh: 光阴似箭，江流长到十八岁，长老给他剃度出家，取法名玄奘，他一心参禅，持斋把素。有一天，暮春时节，众僧在松荫下讲经参禅，一个酒肉和尚被玄奘难倒，恼羞成怒，骂道：你这业畜，连自己的爹娘姓甚名谁都不知道，还在这里捣什么鬼！玄奘听了，哭着跑进方丈跪下，求师父告诉他父母的姓名。长老这才取出那封血书和贴身的汗衫交给他。玄奘读完血书，哭倒在地，发誓说：父母之仇，不能报复，何以为人？长老就叫他扮作化缘的和尚，直奔江州。玄奘来到江州衙门前化斋，正巧殷小姐梦见月缺再圆，出来布施，见这和尚的模样和丈夫一般无二，就叫进来细问。母子相认，殷小姐要看他的左脚，果然缺了一节小指，两人抱头痛哭。母亲嘱咐他：你先到洪州万花店去找你祖母，再拿着我的书信到长安去见你外公殷丞相，叫他奏明唐王，起兵来擒刘贼，替你父亲报仇。玄奘找到万花店，打听得祖母当年没有盘缠，搬进破瓦窑里住，每天沿街乞讨，想念儿子哭得双目失明。玄奘把来历说了，祖母大哭，玄奘用舌尖舔她的双眼，祝祷之后，双眼竟然复明了。玄奘又来到长安，见了外公殷开山。殷丞相读罢女儿的书信，放声大哭，次日奏明唐王，亲自统领六万御林军杀奔江州，活捉了刘洪、李彪。他们把刘洪押到当年行凶的洪江渡口，活剜出心肝，祭奠陈光蕊。洪江龙王得知仇已报了，就把光蕊的尸首送出水面，光蕊伸腰舒臂，竟然苏醒过来，一家人在江边团聚。后来光蕊做了学士，玄奘立意安禅，回到洪福寺修行。
sections.uncertaintyNote: 第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回；有的版本还写到殷小姐最后从容自尽，本节不展开。

sections.bodyEn: Outside Chang'an, by the Jing River, the fisherman Zhang Shao and the woodcutter Li Ding, tipsy and trading verses, argued about whose trade was safer. Zhang Shao said he would never capsize: a fortune-teller on West Gate Street told him every day, for the price of a golden carp, exactly where to cast his nets. A yaksha patrolling the river overheard and told the Dragon King of the Jing River that at this rate the river would be emptied. The furious dragon king seized his sword, but his court of fish and crab officials warned that his clouds and rain would frighten the city and anger heaven; he should investigate first. Disguised as a tall white-robed scholar, he went to West Gate Street and found a crowded booth with the sign of the diviner Yuan Shoucheng, uncle of the court astronomer Yuan Tiangang.
sections.bodyZh: 长安城外的泾河岸边，住着两个不登科的贤人：一个是渔翁，名叫张稍；一个是樵子，名叫李定。这一天两人卖完了柴、卖完了鱼，在酒馆里喝得半醉，一人提着一瓶酒，沿着泾河岸边慢慢走回家，一路上互相吟诗唱和，夸自己的营生好：一个说山里青松翠竹，逍遥自在；一个说水上明月清风，闲来无事。说着说着就斗起嘴来。李定说：张兄，你在水面上讨生活，一旦翻了船，就要葬身鱼腹。还是我在山里砍柴安稳。张稍说：李兄，你在山里，小心被老虎吃了；我呀，永远不会翻船。李定问：凭什么这样肯定？张稍说：你不知道，这长安城西门街上，有一个卖卦的先生。我每天送他一尾金色鲤鱼，他就袖传一课，依着他指的方位下网，百下百着。今天我又去买了卦，他叫我在泾河湾头东边下网，西岸抛钓，定获满载鱼虾而归。明天我再进城卖钱沽酒，再和老兄相叙。两人说笑着各自回家去了。没想到这番话被泾河里巡水的夜叉听见了，他急忙撞进水晶宫，慌慌张张报告龙王：祸事了！长安城西门街上有个卖卦的先生，算得这样准，每天叫那渔翁按方位下网。要是照他这样算下去，用不了多久，泾河里的水族就要被打尽了，还怎样壮观水府，怎样跃浪翻波，辅助大王威力？龙王大怒，提起宝剑就要上长安城去诛灭那卖卦的。龙子、龙孙、虾臣、蟹士、鲥军师、鳜少卿、鲤太宰一齐劝道：大王息怒。常言道，过耳之言，不可听信。大王此去，必有云从、必有雨助，恐怕惊吓了长安的百姓，上天见责。大王何不变化一下，进城访问一番，果有此人，再诛灭不迟；若无此辈，可不是枉害他人吗？龙王依奏，摇身一变，变作一个白衣秀士，身高八尺，丰姿英伟，走进长安城，来到西门街，只见一群人挤在一个卦铺前，门上挂着一块招牌，写着“神课先生袁守诚”——原来他是当朝钦天监台正先生袁天罡的叔父。
sections.headingEn: A fisherman, a woodcutter and a fortune-teller

sections.bodyEn: The dragon king asked about tomorrow's weather. Yuan Shoucheng answered: clouds at the hour of the dragon, thunder at the snake, rain at noon, ending at the goat, three feet three inches and forty-eight drops. The dragon king wagered fifty taels against Yuan's sign and his livelihood, and back in his palace he boasted that rain was his to give. Just then a golden-robed officer brought the Jade Emperor's decree, ordering exactly that rain at exactly those hours. Terrified, he took his adviser's advice: shift the hours a little and hold back a little rain, and the bet was won. Next day he delayed the rain and gave three inches eight drops less, then went to West Gate Street and smashed the fortune-teller's sign, brushes and inkstone.
sections.bodyZh: 龙王挤进卦铺，见袁守诚相貌稀奇、仪容秀丽，便请他占卜一课。袁守诚问：问什么事？龙王说：请卜天上阴晴事如何。袁守诚袖传一课，断道：云迷山顶，雾罩林梢。若占雨泽，准在明朝。龙王问：明天什么时辰下雨？雨有多少尺寸？袁守诚说：明日辰时布云，巳时发雷，午时下雨，未时雨足，共得水三尺三寸零四十八点。龙王笑道：此言不可作戏。如果明天有雨，依你断的时辰、数目，我送你课金五十两奉谢；如果差了些儿，没有雨，或者时辰数目不对，我就打坏你的门面，扯碎你的招牌，即时赶出长安，不许你在此惑众！袁守诚欣然说：这个一定任你。请了，请了，明日雨后来会。龙王辞别回到水府，对水族们夸口：那个卖卦的说明天有雨，还说了时辰点数，我和他打赌了。下雨的事全在我身上，我说不下就不下，看他还怎么胡说！众水族都笑着说：大王是八河都总管、司雨大龙神，有雨无雨，只有大王知道，他怎敢这样乱言？那卖卦的输定了！正在说笑，半空中有人叫道：泾河龙王接旨！原来是一位金衣力士，捧着玉帝的敕旨，写的是：敕命八河总，驱雷掣电行；明朝施雨泽，普济长安城。旨意上的时辰数目，和袁守诚断的毫发不差。龙王吓得魂飞魄散，过了好一会儿才说：尘世上竟有这样灵通的人，真是能通天彻地，我这一赌是输定了！鲥军师在旁边出主意：大王放心，要赢他有何难处？明天下雨时，只要稍稍错一错时辰，克一克点数，就说他断卦不准，还怕不赢？龙王依了。第二天，他故意把时辰推后，到午时才布云、未时才落雨，又少下了三寸八点，雨停以后，又变作秀士，到西门街卦铺前，二话不说，把袁守诚的招牌、笔砚一齐打得粉碎。

sections.bodyEn: Yuan Shoucheng laughed at the wrecked booth: he knew the scholar was the Jing River dragon king, who by changing heaven's decree had earned execution at a quarter past noon tomorrow — and the executioner would be Chief Minister Wei Zheng. The terrified dragon begged for help, and Yuan advised him to plead with Emperor Taizong. That night the dragon appeared in the emperor's dream, and Taizong promised to save him. Next day the emperor kept Wei Zheng at chess; at a quarter past noon Wei Zheng fell asleep over the board, and the emperor let him rest. Waking, Wei Zheng confessed that in his dream he had left his body and beheaded a dragon — and just then Qin Shubao and Xu Maogong ran in to report that a bleeding dragon's head had fallen from the clouds.
sections.bodyZh: 袁守诚坐在那里纹丝不动，龙王又抡起门板就打，骂道：你这妄言祸福的妖人，擅惑众心的泼汉！你的卦不灵，言语虚谬，说今日下雨的时辰点数都不对，你还敢高坐在上？快滚出去，饶你死罪！袁守诚仰面朝天冷笑道：我不怕，我不怕！我无死罪，只怕你倒有个死罪哩！别人好瞒，只是难瞒我。我认得你，你不是秀士，乃是泾河龙王。你违了玉帝敕旨，改了时辰，克了点数，犯了天条。你在那剐龙台上，恐怕难免一刀，你还在这里骂我？龙王一听，心惊胆战，毛骨悚然，急忙丢下门板，整衣伏礼，向先生跪下说：先生休怪，前言戏之耳，岂知弄假成真，果然违犯天条，奈何？望先生救我一救！不然，我死也不放你。袁守诚说：我救你不得，只是指条生路给你投生便了。你明日午时三刻，该赴人曹官魏征处听斩。你果要性命，须当急急去告当今唐太宗皇帝方好——那魏征是唐王驾下的丞相，若是讨他个人情，方保无事。龙王含泪辞去。这天夜里，龙王闯进太宗的梦中，跪在面前哀告：陛下救我！我是泾河龙王，犯了天条，该陛下的贤臣魏征处斩，故来拜求，望陛下救我一救！太宗在梦中答应了。第二天早朝散后，太宗特意留下魏征，叫他进宫下棋，想把他拖过午时三刻。两人一着一着地下到午时三刻，一盘残局未了，魏征忽然伏在棋盘上，鼾鼾地睡着了。太宗笑道：贤卿真是匡扶社稷，心劳力倦，所以不觉盹睡。任他睡着，也不叫醒。不多时魏征醒来，俯伏在地说：臣该万死！臣刚才一时昏迷，不知所为，望陛下赦臣慢君之罪。太宗问他做了什么，魏征说：臣的身子在君前，梦却离了陛下，驾云去剐龙台上，斩了一条龙。话音未落，秦叔宝、徐茂功等人飞报进来：千步廊南边十字街头，云端里落下一颗龙头，血淋淋的，特来启奏！

sections.bodyEn: From then on the dragon's ghost came at night carrying its head, crying to Taizong to give back its life and come argue before the judges of the dead; once a heavenly lady waved a willow sprig and drove it off — Guanyin protecting him unseen. But the haunting went on and the emperor grew weak. The generals Qin Shubao and Yuchi Jingde stood guard at the palace gate all night in full armour, and the ghost did not dare come; to spare them, the emperor had their portraits painted and hung on the gate — which, the novel says, is why households paste them up as door gods. When the ghost turned to the back gate, Wei Zheng guarded it with the sword that had killed the dragon. Still the emperor's illness worsened. Wei Zheng gave him a letter for his sworn friend Cui Jue, a former minister now keeper of the underworld registers, and Taizong died with it in his sleeve.
sections.bodyZh: 太宗见了龙头，心中又惊又悔，回宫后闷闷不乐。到了夜里二更时分，只听得宫门外有号泣之声，泾河龙王的冤魂手提着一颗血淋淋的首级，高叫：唐太宗！还我命来！还我命来！你昨夜满口许诺救我，怎么天明时反宣人曹官来斩我？你出来，你出来！我与你到阎君处折辩折辩！他扯住太宗再三不放，太宗箝口难言，只挣得汗流遍体。正在难分难解之时，只见正南上香云缭绕，彩雾飘飘，有一个女真人上前，将杨柳枝用手一摆，那没头的龙悲悲啼啼，往西北而去——原来这是观音菩萨暗中护持。可是从这以后，太宗夜夜不得安宁，梦中常有鬼魅抛砖弄瓦，三宫六院都不得安生，太宗的身体一天天衰弱下去。大将秦叔宝和尉迟敬德自告奋勇，全身披挂，手持金瓜钺斧，整夜站在宫门外守卫。一夜过去，果然平安无事。太宗心疼两位将军彻夜辛苦，就叫巧手丹青画了两人的真容，照他们披挂的样子贴在宫门两边，从此夜夜无事。后人就把他们当作门神，世代相传。前门安静了，后门又响起砖瓦声来，魏征便手提那口诛龙的宝剑，侍立在后宰门前，彻夜不睡，那后门也就安静了。可是太宗的病仍然一天重似一天，眼看就要不起了。魏征从袖中取出一封书信说：陛下宽心，臣有一事，管保陛下长生。阴司里有个判官，名叫崔珏，是太上先皇帝驾前的臣子，先受兹州令，后升礼部侍郎，在世时和臣是八拜之交，相交甚厚。他如今掌管阴司的生死文簿。请陛下把这封书信带去，见了他自会照应。太宗接过书信，笼在袖里，便瞑目而亡。
sections.headingEn: The door gods and the emperor's death

sections.bodyEn: Taizong's soul was received by the judge Cui Jue, who read Wei Zheng's letter. The Ten Kings of the underworld told the emperor the dragon's death had been fated and was not his fault; the dragon had already been sent on to rebirth. When the register of life and death was brought, Cui Jue saw 'thirteenth year of Zhenguan' and quickly added two strokes to make it 'thirty-third', and the kings sent the emperor back with twenty more years. On the way he saw the eighteen hells and the Bridge of No Choice; in the City of the Wrongly Dead the ghosts of the rebels and bandits killed in his wars blocked his path, so Cui Jue had him borrow a vault of treasure stored in the underworld by a good man of Kaifeng named Xiang Liang to pay them, and the emperor promised a great mass for the dead. After the six paths of rebirth he was pushed into the Wei River and woke in his coffin.
sections.bodyZh: 太宗的魂魄出了五凤楼，恍恍惚惚，被引到一处荒郊，判官崔珏前来迎接，跪在路旁说：微臣有失远迎。太宗把魏征的书信交给他，崔判官读罢满口答应，引着太宗来到森罗宝殿。十代阎王出殿相迎，问起泾河龙王告状一事，太宗说：朕梦中曾许救他，不期他犯罪当刑，该朕的人曹官魏征处斩，朕宣魏征在殿着棋，不知他一梦而斩，这是那人曹官出没神机，又是那龙王犯罪当死，岂是朕之过也？十王说：那龙未生之前，南斗星死簿上已注定该遭杀于人曹之手，我等早已知之。只是他在此折辩，定要陛下来此三曹对案。现已将他送入轮藏，转生去了。今又有劳陛下降临，望乞恕我催促之罪。阎王命掌案判官取生死簿来，查看太宗的阳寿。崔判官急转司房，抢先把簿子翻开一看，只见上面写着“南赡部洲大唐太宗皇帝，注定贞观一十三年”。他吃了一惊，急忙取过浓墨大笔，在“一”字上添了两画，改成“三十三年”，然后呈上。阎王一看，说：陛下登基多少年了？太宗说：朕即位今一十三年了。阎王说：陛下宽心勿虑，还有二十年阳寿。便叫崔判官和朱太尉送太宗还阳。一路上，太宗看见了阴山背后的十八层地狱，看见了奈何桥下的血浪，又来到枉死城，只见成群的冤魂——都是当年六十四处烟尘、七十二处草寇的亡魂——一齐拦住索命。崔判官说：河南开封府有一个人，姓相名良，他有十三库金银寄存在阴司。陛下可以先借他一库，分给这些饿鬼，他们才肯放行。太宗依言做了，又许下回阳后做一场水陆大会，超度这些无主的孤魂。最后来到六道轮回之处，看过行善的升化仙道、作恶的沉沦鬼道，二人把太宗领到渭河边上，乘他不备，一把推进河中，太宗大叫一声，在棺材里活了过来。

sections.bodyEn: Restored to life, Taizong freed the prisoners and sought someone to take melons to the Ten Kings as he had promised. Liu Quan of Junzhou, whose wife Li Cuilian had hanged herself after he scolded her for giving a golden hairpin to a monk, volunteered to die. With melons on his head and poison in his mouth he went to the underworld and offered them; the kings, finding that both he and his wife had long lives still due, sent them back. As Cuilian's body had decayed, her soul entered the body of the emperor's sister Li Yuying, who had just collapsed and died. The princess woke speaking with a Junzhou accent and calling for her husband; the emperor gave her dowry to Liu Quan and sent them home. The poor water-seller Xiang Liang refused repayment, so Yuchi Jingde built the Xiangguo Monastery with the money.
sections.bodyZh: 太宗还阳以后，大赦天下，把死囚都放回家中与父母妻子团聚，又出榜招贤，要找人把南瓜送到阴司去，答谢十代阎王——那是他在阴间答应过的。均州有个人名叫刘全，家财万贯。只因他的妻子李翠莲在门首拔下头上的金钗，斋僧施舍，刘全骂她不遵妇道，擅出闺门。李翠莲忍气不过，自缢而死，撇下一双儿女，昼夜啼哭。刘全又悔又恨，也舍不得这条命再活下去，情愿舍了家缘，撇了儿女，以死进瓜。他揭了皇榜，来见唐王。太宗叫他到金亭馆里，头顶一对南瓜，袖带黄钱，口噙药物，服毒而死。刘全的魂魄顶着南瓜，来到鬼门关前，被引到森罗殿上献瓜。阎王接了瓜，十分欢喜，问起刘全的来历，刘全把妻子自缢的事说了。阎王叫人查看，李翠莲正在阴司，于是夫妻相见。查看生死簿，夫妻二人都有登仙之寿，阎王就叫鬼使送他们还阳。鬼使说：李翠莲归阴日久，尸首已经腐坏了，魂魄没处依附。阎王说：唐太宗的御妹李玉英，今该促死。可借她的尸首，叫她还魂去吧。鬼使把李翠莲的魂魄推进皇宫，正赶上御妹李玉英在花荫下行走，一个跟头跌倒，气绝身亡。不一会儿，御妹竟又醒了过来，开口就叫：丈夫慢些走，等我一等！满口均州乡音，还说宫里的人她一个都不认得。太宗大惊，问明原委，原来是借尸还魂。刘全也已在金亭馆复活。太宗便把御妹的妆奁衣物首饰尽数赏给刘全，叫他们夫妻回均州团聚。太宗又派尉迟敬德带着金银去开封府还给相良。相良夫妻是卖水的穷人，坚决不肯收，说：小的若受了这些金银，就死得快了。尉迟恭便用这些钱修建了一座寺院，取名“敕建相国寺”，又在寺中立碑，记下这件事。

sections.bodyEn: To keep his underworld promise, Taizong summoned the eminent monks and the court recommended Xuanzang, a vegetarian from birth with a famous pedigree and mastery of the sutras; the emperor made him chief monk of the realm, with the altar at Huasheng Monastery. Meanwhile Guanyin and Muzha were in the streets offering the Buddha's cassock for five thousand taels and the staff for two thousand, laughed at as mad monks. Chief Minister Xiao Yu brought them to the emperor. Guanyin praised the cassock's powers and said that to a man who did not honour the Three Jewels the price would be seven thousand, but to one who did she would give them free — and she gave both for Xuanzang and left without payment. When he walked through Chang'an in the cassock with the staff, people said a living arhat had come down to earth.
sections.bodyZh: 太宗要兑现在阴司许下的诺言，召集天下高僧，要选一位有德行的大阐都僧纲，在化生寺开设水陆大会。众臣推举了玄奘，说他自幼为僧，出娘胎就持斋受戒，外公是当朝殷丞相，父亲是状元陈光蕊，根源又好，德行又高，千经万典无所不通，佛号仙音无般不会。太宗大喜，赐他五彩织金袈裟一件、毗卢帽一顶，封为左僧纲、右僧纲、天下大阐都僧纲之职，在化生寺选定吉日开演经法。这时，观音菩萨和木叉早已在长安街上，捧着如来所赐的锦襕袈裟和九环锡杖叫卖。有个愚僧问价，菩萨说：袈裟价值五千两，锡杖价值二千两。那愚僧笑道：这两个癫和尚是疯子，是傻子！这两件粗物，就卖得七千两银子？宰相萧瑀散朝回来，见了觉得蹊跷，把他们带进宫去见太宗。菩萨对太宗说：这袈裟，龙披一缕，免大鹏吞噬之灾；鹤挂一丝，得超凡入圣之妙。但坐处，有万神朝礼；凡举动，有七佛随身。这锡杖，铜镶铁造九连环，九节仙藤永驻颜。太宗问：那和尚，你这袈裟、锡杖，端的要卖多少价钱？菩萨说：若是不遵佛法、不敬三宝、谤佛毁僧的人，就要七千两银子，这便是贵了；若是敬重三宝、见善随喜、皈依我佛的人，承受得起，我情愿送给他，与我结个善缘。太宗正想为玄奘求一件好袈裟，菩萨便把两件宝贝都送了出来，不肯收一文钱，转身就走了。太宗召玄奘进朝，叫他当场把袈裟披上、锡杖拿在手中，又命他沿着长安大街走一遭。只见满城男女都来观看，个个夸赞：好个法师！真是个活罗汉下降，活菩萨临凡！

sections.bodyEn: On the seventh day of the mass, while Xuanzang preached from the high altar before the emperor, the scabby monk struck the altar and asked whether he could only teach the Lesser Vehicle. Xuanzang gladly came down to learn more. Seized as a disturber, the monk told the emperor that the Lesser Vehicle could not save the dead, whereas the Great Vehicle in three baskets, kept by the Buddha at the Thunderclap Monastery in India, could undo every grievance. Then Guanyin revealed her true form on an auspicious cloud, with vase and willow, Muzha beside her, and the whole city knelt. A note floated down: in the west there were wondrous scriptures, a hundred and eight thousand li away; brought back, they would save the ghosts, and whoever went would win a golden body. The emperor at once asked who would go.
sections.bodyZh: 水陆大会开到第七天，太宗亲自摆驾，带领文武百官到化生寺拈香。玄奘正在高台上宣讲《受生度亡经》，谈《安邦天宝篆》，又宣《劝修功卷》。那疥癞和尚也挤在人群中听讲，忽然走上台前，拍着宝台高声叫道：那和尚，你只会谈小乘教法，可会谈大乘吗？玄奘闻言，心中大喜，翻身跳下台来，对菩萨起手道：老师父，弟子失瞻，多罪。见前的盖众僧人，都讲的是小乘教法，却不知大乘教法如何。菩萨说：你这小乘教法，度不得亡者超升，只可浑俗和光而已。我有大乘佛法三藏，能超亡者升天，能度难人脱苦，能修无量寿身，能作无来无去。正说着，护卫的官员把这个扰乱法会的和尚拿到太宗面前。太宗问：你既来听讲，只该吃些斋便了，为何与我法师乱讲，扰乱经堂，误我佛事？菩萨说：你那法师讲的是小乘教法，度不得亡者升天。我有大乘佛法三藏，可以度亡脱苦，寿身无坏。太宗问：你那大乘佛法，在于何处？菩萨说：在大西天天竺国大雷音寺我佛如来处，能解百冤之结，能消无妄之灾。太宗问：你可记得么？菩萨说：我记得。说罢，菩萨和木叉飞上高台，踏着祥云，直到九霄，现出救苦原身：头上金叶冠，身上翠纹裙，手托净瓶，瓶中插着杨柳，木叉在旁侍立。满城的官员、僧人、百姓全都跪下叩头，太宗也在殿前朝天礼拜。菩萨在空中留下一张简帖，飘飘落下，上面写道：礼上大唐君，西方有妙文。程途十万八千里，大乘进殷勤。此经回上国，能超鬼出群。若有肯去者，求正果金身。太宗当即下令：谁愿意领朕旨意，上西天拜佛求经？

sections.bodyEn: Xuanzang knelt and volunteered. The delighted emperor raised him up and swore brotherhood with him before the Buddha, calling him his imperial brother. At Hongfu Monastery his disciples warned that the road was full of tigers and demons; Xuanzang said he had vowed not to return without the scriptures — if the branches of the pine by the gate turned east, he was coming back. On the day of departure the emperor led his court to the city's pass and gave him a sealed travel rescript, a purple-gold begging bowl, two attendants and a white horse. Since the scriptures were in three baskets, the emperor named him Sanzang. When Sanzang promised to return in three years, the emperor picked up a pinch of dust and flicked it into his wine: better to love a pinch of home soil than ten thousand taels of foreign gold. Sanzang drank it and rode west, three days before the full moon of the ninth month of the thirteenth year of Zhenguan.
sections.bodyZh: 话音刚落，玄奘从旁边闪出，走上前来，拜伏在地：贫僧不才，愿效犬马之劳，与陛下求取真经，祈保我王江山永固。太宗非常高兴，亲手把他扶起来说：法师果能尽此忠贤，不怕程途遥远，跋涉山川，朕情愿与你拜为兄弟。玄奘叩头谢恩。太宗当即在佛前与玄奘拜了四拜，称他为御弟圣僧。玄奘回到洪福寺，寺里的徒弟们都来相见，问起西行的事，都说：我们听说西天路远，更多虎豹妖魔，只怕有去无回，难保身命。玄奘说：我已发了弘誓大愿，不取真经，永堕沉沦地狱。大抵是受王恩宠，不得不尽忠以报国耳。我这一去，路途遥远，少则二三年，多则五七年。你们看山门里的松枝，枝头要是向东，我即回来；不然，断不回矣。出发这天，太宗率领文武百官，一直送到长安城外的关口。太宗赐给玄奘通关文牒，上面用了通行的宝印，又赐紫金钵盂一个，供他途中化斋；又选了两个长行的从者、一匹白马，给他做远行的脚力。太宗问：御弟雅号甚称？玄奘说：贫僧出家人，未敢称号。太宗说：当时菩萨说，西天有经三藏。御弟可指经取号，号作三藏何如？玄奘谢恩，从此人称唐三藏。临别时，太宗举起一杯素酒，问：御弟这一去，到西天几时可回？三藏说：只在三年，径回上国。太宗弯下腰，用手指从地上捻起一撮尘土，弹进酒杯里。三藏不解其意，太宗笑道：御弟呵，这一去到西天，几时可回？宁恋本乡一捻土，莫爱他乡万两金。三藏这才明白御兄的意思，再次谢恩，把酒一饮而尽，辞别了众人，策马出关，往西而去。这一天，是贞观十三年九月望前三日。
